# exe: /home/ubuntu/.local/bin/firebase
# args: 
Usage: firebase emulators [options] [command]

start and manage local Firebase emulators

Options:
  -h, --help                         display help for command

Commands:
  emulators:exec [options] <script>  start the local Firebase emulators, run
                                     a test script, then shut down the
                                     emulators
  emulators:export [options] <path>  export data from running emulators
  emulators:start [options]          start the local Firebase emulators

To see more about a specific command, run:
  firebase emulators:<command> --help
